name: Improved Scene Parameterization Function
definition: An improvement over NDC and Barron et al. (2022) to constrain long-range street view sequences into a bounded range before position encoding, avoiding heavy range compression of close objects and providing more details for close object rendering.
summary: The Improved Scene Parameterization Function constrains street view sequences into a bounded range using a piecewise contraction with derivative continuity, avoiding the heavy range compression of close objects inherent in Normalized Device Coordinates.
